sentences.text: 3. Heard, Mr. Amitav Tripathy, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. R.B.Mishra, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
None appears for the informant despite being duly noticed through concerned Police Station as informed by the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
At the outset, Mr.Tripathy makes available to the Court the certified copy of deposition of PWs. 1 to 6 including that of victim.

4. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offence alleged against the appellant vis-a-vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and on going through the evidence of the victim and keeping in view the pre-trial detention of the appellant in custody since 26.05.2024 with progress of trial, this Court without expressing any view on the merits, admits the appellant to bail.
